messages:
lauren_ops: Quick coordination  Product Manager candidate (Samira K.) booked Mon 2026-07-20, onsite 10:00-16:00 PT. Candidate flagged neurodiversity accommodations: prefers written task instructions, extra 10 mins between interviews, a quiet low-sensory room for a timed exercise, and permission to take notes. Also asked about local train stipend.
priya: Thanks Lauren. We typically provide transit stipends. What's the approved cap for regional trains?
recruiter_ana: Samira is arriving by Caltrain from SF. Requested up to $40 round-trip. She asked whether we reimburse pre-paid e-tickets or provide on-the-spot credit.
priya: We can pre-approve a $40 transit stipend via ACH (expense code OPS-TRN-2026) if recruiter shares payment details. Otherwise candidate can submit receipt after and ops will reimburse within 5 business days.
ellie_ops: For the room, Quiet Suite B is best (low lighting, no wall art, soft seating). Reserving 09:45-16:15 to include buffers. Will set a small sign: "Private meeting in progress" to minimize interruptions.
lauren_ops: Can we also reserve a private laptop for the timed exercise (no camera, local-only)? Candidate prefers no recording.
it_helpdesk: We have a sanitized loaner (Linux, local account) we can reserve. We'll disable camera and network shares, ensure no recording software, and create a guest profile with Chrome + local editor.
peopleops_bot: Checklist created: Quiet Suite B booking, loaner device w/ guest profile, transit stipend pre-approval, written instructions for panel, 10-min buffers between sessions, front-desk note. Reminder: send arrival instructions 24h prior.
recruiter_ana: Samira also asked about bringing a support device (small wearable). Any policy notes?
ellie_ops: Support devices are allowed; front desk will have a discreet greeter and a private locker for personal items if needed. We'll ensure electrical outlet nearby.
priya: Note on written task instructions  hiring manager please provide a doc version of any whiteboard/pairing prompt 24h in advance and allow candidate to read prompts quietly before starting. Also confirm timed exercise length; ops will block the room accordingly.
lauren_ops: Hiring manager (Nate) agreed to a 35-min timed exercise and will send written prompt by Fri. We'll do a 10-min buffer after for notes.
recruiter_ana: Candidate asked whether interviews will be recorded or transcribed. We will not record; live notes only per panelist. I'll include that in candidate packet.
priya: I'll process transit stipend once recruiter DM's payout details. Also will include a note about meal voucher (vegetarian option requested). Lunch voucher up to $25, digital code to be sent EOD.
lauren_ops: Anything about accessibility signage? Candidate prefers minimal sensory stimuli; front desk please avoid loud announcements.
ellie_ops: Noted  Reception will use quiet greeting, no announcements. We'll post discreet instructions for direction to Quiet Suite B.
it_helpdesk: Reminder to panelists: loaner guest account ready at 09:30; IT will test offline environment at 09:15.
peopleops_bot: Calendar invite sent: 1968001234-PM-SAMIRA with 24h and 30m reminders. Arrival instruction reminder scheduled 24h prior.
recruiter_ana: I'll DM payment info for stipend now and confirm Samira's ETA tomorrow morning. Thanks team.
lauren_ops: Thanks all  appreciate the quick turnaround :raised_hands:
